In addition, writes land on the SSD first and reach the disks later. Faster, but for a while the SSD holds data that exists only there.

The write cache lives on exactly one SSD; there is no mirror for it. If this SSD fails, all data not yet written back to the disks is lost and the file system may be damaged. If the SSD is missing at start, the volume stays unmounted. Use the read and write cache only with a UPS and a current data backup.
